firm_data.firm_description: Pomerantz LLP is the oldest law firm in the world dedicated to representing defrauded investors. Founded in 1936, the firm champions shareholder and consumer rights and has shaped the law through landmark decisions.
notable_facts: The firm was founded in 1936 by Abe Pomerantz.
Pomerantz has recovered billions of dollars on behalf of defrauded investors.
The firm has offices in New York City, Chicago, Los Angeles, London, Paris and Tel Aviv.

additional_contacts.name: Nicolas Tatin

email.subject: AI for Pomerantz LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Jeremy,

PomTrack is a smart move for portfolio monitoring, and I imagine your team at Pomerantz is constantly balancing depth of analysis with the volume securities litigation demands. That's exactly where we see firms like yours gaining an edge.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding to meet firms tackling complex shareholder and corporate governance matters. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar practices compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
